WITH active AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA'
            AND source_table='OINV' AND canceled='N' AND doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND doc_date<'2027-01-01'),
            unclassified AS (SELECT l.currency,count(*) AS n,sum(TRY_CAST(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS amount
                FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l WHERE l.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND l.source_table='INV1'
                AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM read_parquet(['/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/business/material_supply/TELCHI_DATALAKE_MATERIAL_SUPPLY_FINALIZATION_V1/material_supply_status/full/material-supply-final-1790303719477148466_material_supply_status_full/part-00000.parquet'], union_by_name=true) m WHERE m."ItemCode"=l.item_code)
                AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active d WHERE d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry) GROUP BY l.currency)
            SELECT min(doc_date),max(doc_date),min(source_as_of),max(source_as_of),
            (SELECT count(*) FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/products/part-00000.parquet') WHERE source_system='SAP_HANA'),
            (SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT code) FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/customers/part-00000.parquet') WHERE source_system='SAP_HANA'),
            (SELECT to_json(list(struct_pack(currency:=currency,lines:=n,amount:=amount))) FROM unclassified),
            to_json(list(DISTINCT strftime(TRY_CAST(doc_date AS DATE),'%Y-%m'))),
            count(*)-count(DISTINCT doc_entry),
            (SELECT to_json(list(struct_pack(code:=item_code,name:=sap_item_name,grp:=sap_itms_grp_cod)))
                FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/products/part-00000.parquet') WHERE source_system='SAP_HANA'
                AND item_code IN (SELECT item_code FROM verify_raw_items)) FROM active

                CAST(TRY_CAST(d.doc_date AS DATE) AS VARCHAR),d.raw_extraction_id AS document_extraction
                FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d ON d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry
